issues.description: The solution's assembleBookstore method has a return-type mismatch: the problem statement and the template expect assembleBookstore() to return a Bookstore, and the solution's main() assigns let bookstore = assembleBookstore(). However, in the solution repository assembleBookstore is declared as returning Void (-> Void) while it actually returns a Bookstore at the end of the function. This mismatch will cause a compilation error and prevents the program from building/running as shown in the solution.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the assembleBookstore function signature in the solution to return a Bookstore (private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore { ... }) so it matches the problem description and the template usage in main(), and ensure the function returns the constructed Bookstore. This preserves the intended design and fixes the compile-time error.
